text:
Aisha Patel: Quick async: noticed p95 regress on canary after prefetch change. What I did: rolled prefetch v2 to 10% canary on staging, ran microbench (50k qps mixed), inspected KV hit rates. Blocker: p95 up ~12ms vs baseline, tail seems tied to slot handoff. Today: trying to reproduce locally and add extra telemetry. Logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-10T10:12:34Z] batcher: evict slot 42 took 8ms
[2026-03-10T10:12:34Z] kv: read latency 0.7ms
[2026-03-10T10:12:35Z] kernel: slot-reassign wait 9ms
```

Santiago Ruiz: :eyes: can you dump perf counters around the slot mutex? I suspect contention when batches overlap.

Aisha Patel: good call. I added a perf counter span id=slot-reassign in the canary, will share trace link once processed.

Maya Chen: did you see any difference in batch sizes / microburst distribution? last time we tuned microbatcher we saw correlated p95 jumps.

Aisha Patel: batch size distribution looks same (mostly 1-4), but there's a 0.6% spike in 8-12 microburst windows during canary.

Priya Singh: pinging infra — @infra-bot can you confirm no noisy neighbor on gpunode-7 at that time?

infra-bot: gpunode-7 metrics: cpu 43%, mem 62%, io wait <1%, no OOMs in window 10:00-10:20 UTC

Jamie Park: quick idea — try disabling slot handoff for a single model shard, see if p95 drops. Can we toggle via /config?

Aisha Patel: yes can toggle per-shard. I'll disable handoff for shard 3 on canary and rerun microbench in 30m.

Santiago Ruiz: if that reduces tail we know it's handoff. If not, collect stackshots for the kernel thread at tail times.

Aisha Patel: 👍 will follow up with results. Blocker: need a small helper patch to expose slot handoff metric; will open PR and ping reviewers.

Maya Chen: quick review ping when ready, I'll take it.

Aisha Patel: thanks — TL;DR: investigating p95 regression after prefetch v2 canary; next steps disable handoff for shard 3, collect traces and stackshots; PR incoming. End.
